elaine (sec-eng): Hey — I found a weird gap in our backup re-encryption after a GCS lifecycle transition. Archived DB snapshot objects moved to Nearline, and when the lifecycle copy happened the objects lost the KMS envelope metadata. Our nightly re-encrypt job sees them as already-encrypted and skips them, but they actually lack the CMEK wrapper. Repro below, and example logs.

mike (infra): ouch. timeline? how many tenants affected?

elaine (sec-eng): Not many so far — spotted 3 tenant buckets in staging and 2 in prod. Lifecycle rule ran 02:10 UTC this morning. Re-encrypt job runs at 03:00 UTC, and that's when we missed them. Logs show job skipping based on metadata header mismatch.

rachel (encops): can you paste the minimal repro steps and the metadata snapshot? maybe it's multipart/composed objects losing headers.

elaine (sec-eng): repro steps (staging):
```
# upload chunked snapshot
gsutil -m cp -r ./snapshots/2026-03-20 gs://redwood-backups/tenant-42/snapshots/
# lifecycle rule composes/copies to nearline class
# after lifecycle transition, check metadata
gsutil stat gs://redwood-backups/tenant-42/snapshots/2026-03-20/part-0001
```
Observed metadata before lifecycle:
```
x-goog-meta-encryption: CMEK
x-goog-meta-kms-key: projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/backup/cryptoKeys/tenant-42
content-type: application/octet-stream
storage-class: STANDARD
```
After lifecycle copy/compose:
```
x-goog-meta-encryption: sse
content-type: application/octet-stream
storage-class: NEARLINE
# kms key header missing
```

sam (sre): devops-bot log snippet from the re-encrypt job at 03:00 shows skip reason?

devops-bot: job re-encrypt-backups-03:00
```
INFO 03:00:03 scanning bucket redwood-backups/tenant-42
INFO 03:00:12 found object part-0001 storageClass=NEARLINE metadata.encryption=sse
INFO 03:00:12 skip object part-0001 reason=metadata.indicates_encrypted
WARNING 03:00:13 attempted_kms_wrap=false
```

rachel (encops): That skip heuristic is brittle. We relied on a metadata flag set by the uploader. Lifecycle copy/composed objects can drop custom metadata unless you set `--preserve-metadata` or use object-version-copy with metadata piping. GCS compose will not preserve user metadata by default in some cases.

mike (infra): Can we pause the lifecycle rule on the two prod buckets immediately? If we stop transitions we can run a corrective re-encrypt before more objects get moved.

lucas (platform): I can flip the lifecycle rule to disabled for the two affected buckets in <5m. Also proposing a patch: change re-encrypt job detection to validate by attempting an envelope-decrypt metadata call with KMS (cheap head-call) rather than trusting a boolean metadata flag.

elaine (sec-eng): Good. Short-term mitigation: pause lifecycle and run a scan job that checks object metadata + attempts a lightweight KMS decrypt-check. If decrypt-check fails but metadata says "encrypted", mark for repair. We should also find any objects that were composed (multipart) in the last 24h.

sam (sre): I'll create a runbook step and run a one-off scanner. Runbook snippet:
```
# list candidate objects
gsutil ls -r gs://redwood-backups/tenant-*/snapshots/** | while read o; do
  meta=$(gsutil stat "$o" | grep x-goog-meta-encryption)
  if [ "$meta" = "x-goog-meta-encryption: CMEK" ]; then
    # attempt decrypt-check
    curl -s -X POST "$KMS_API/wrapCheck" -d "{object:$o}" || echo "$o" >> /tmp/needs-rewrap
  fi
done
```

rachel (encops): For repair we should: 1) copy object to a temp key with KMS encrypt (server-side) to rewrap; 2) verify checksum; 3) atomically replace original or write new version and update index. Avoid double-decrypt of plaintext on client side.

mike (infra): Will this cause high egress or KMS QPS? We should throttle and run tenant-by-tenant. Also notify customers in case SLA/consistency risk.

elaine (sec-eng): Good point — throttle KMS wrap ops to 50 QPS, and prefer server-side rewrap (cloud provider copy + kms destination key) to avoid plaintext. For GCS we can use ObjectRewrite with kmsKeyName set.

lucas (platform): Patch PR in flight: re-encrypt job now will:
- detect via attempted KMS metadata check instead of header
- retry object-rewrite with kmsKeyName on failure
- emit audit log entry `backup.rewrap.attempt` with old/new metadata

PR link: https://git.internal.redwood/repo/platform/pulls/542

oncall-bot: incident created INC-2026-93 (priority P2) — assigned to encops and infra.

rachel (encops): Also need to add audit-log alert: if lifecycle transition + metadata-change occurs in same hour for >5 objects, page SRE. Right now those events are noisy in audit, so we need a correlation rule.

sam (sre): Acknowledge. I'll add a temporary alert rule and schedule a postmortem if more than 10 objects affected in prod.

elaine (sec-eng): Final ask: check backup restore path. If a customer requests a restore and object lacks proper CMEK wrapper, the restore path must fail closed and we must not return data until rewrap completes and key access verified. Add a gating check in the restore handler.

mike (infra): Agreed. I'll put that gating check on the restore lambda and log explicit error code `ERR_RESTORED_OBJ_UNWRAPPED`.

rachel (encops): I'll own coordination with compliance for an incident notification to our auditors (we may have had a temporary lapse of CMEK wrapping for a tiny subset). Draft notice prepared.

elaine (sec-eng): Thanks everyone. Action items summarized:
- lucas: disable lifecycle on affected buckets (in progress) ✅
- sam: run scanner and generate /tmp/needs-rewrap list
- lucas: push re-encrypt job patch and deploy canary
- mike: throttle KMS QPS and update restore gating code
- rachel: incident notification + compliance brief
- all: re-evaluate lifecycle -> compose behavior and update docs

elaine (sec-eng): tagging @oncall-bot for followups :eyes:

oncall-bot: noted. Will post follow-up when rewrap complete or if escalation needed.

sam (sre): quick note: small fix applied — we now treat objects with storageClass=NEARLINE and missing `x-goog-meta-kms-key` as high-priority in scanner. Running now.

lucas (platform): will monitor PR build and canary metrics. :thumbsup:

mike (infra): ping me if you need KMS grant changes for the rewrite service account.

elaine (sec-eng): closing here after actions; will update thread with remediation completion and postmortem link.
